scope: 20issuer/four-industry historical PIT prototype; no model search
quarter_grid: 2012Q1-2022Q4, 44 calendar quarters; do not force post-exit observations
selection: Purposive technical/identity stress sample locked before new systematic recovery, not a random historical universe. Four known exit/restructuring cases included deliberately; this does not by itself remove selection bias. No stock chosen by forecast gain.
primary_data_source: SEC original accession and original XBRL/inline XBRL; official filing detail or SGML acceptance timezone independently verified
fetch_policy: normal public access only, <=1 request per second, no retries after a repeated explicit403/429; no proxy/header rotation to evade SEC limits; retain response bodies and failures
companyfacts_policy: Do not download current companyfacts containing2026 numeric facts; use dated original filings or historical FSDS instead
manual_sampling: target10 original/revision documents per company spread across<=2022 filing years; without enough originals mark NOT_EVALUABLE, never count repeated pages/facts as separate documents
variance_gate: Only if authenticated original fundamentals, vintage history, reliable prices/actions/identity and >=six fixed comparison forecast series are available on development dates; otherwise NOT_ESTIMABLE, never impute missing evidence as zero
short_term_output: honest data/identity/as-of engineering and failure audit working paper, separate from prospective confirmation
